content.en: The **Harappan Civilization** (Indus Valley Civilisation) stands out in the ancient world primarily due to its remarkable and standardized **town planning**. Unlike contemporary urban centers in Mesopotamia or Egypt, Harappan cities demonstrate a profound understanding of municipal engineering, public health, and spatial organization. The uniform nature of city layouts across vast geographical distances indicates centralized governance, urban administration, and adherence to strict civic regulations. Excavations at major sites like **Harappa**, **Mohenjo-daro**, and **Dholavira** reveal that urban design was not accidental but preconceived before settlement construction began.
content.hi: **हरप्पा सभ्यता** (सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता) प्राचीन दुनिया में मुख्य रूप से अपनी उल्लेखनीय और मानकीकृत **नगर योजना** के कारण विशिष्ट है। मेसोपोटामिया या मिस्र के समकालीन शहरी केंद्रों के विपरीत, हरप्पा के शहर नगरपालिका इंजीनियरिंग, सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य और स्थानिक संगठन की गहरी समझ का प्रदर्शन करते हैं। विशाल भौगोलिक दूरियों में शहर के लेआउट की एक समान प्रकृति केंद्रीकृत शासन, शहरी प्रशासन और कड़े नागरिक नियमों के पालन को इंगित करती है। **हरप्पा**, **मोहनजोदड़ो** और **धोलावीरा** जैसे प्रमुख स्थलों पर की गई खुदाई से पता चलता है कि शहरी डिज़ाइन आकस्मिक नहीं था, बल्कि बस्ती का निर्माण शुरू होने से पहले ही पूर्व-कल्पित था।

rows.en: Streets intersecting at right angles (90 degrees)
rows.hi: सड़कें समकोण (90 डिग्री) पर काटती हैं

rows.en: Main streets oriented North-South and East-West, dividing cities into rectangular or square blocks
rows.hi: मुख्य सड़कें उत्तर-दक्षिण और पूर्व-पश्चिम की ओर उन्मुख, शहरों को आयताकार या वर्गाकार ब्लॉकों में विभाजित करती हैं

rows.en: Western citadel raised on mud-brick platforms for elites/public structures; Eastern lower town for residential dwellings
rows.hi: अभिजात वर्ग/सार्वजनिक संरचनाओं के लिए मिट्टी की ईंटों के मंच पर उठाया गया पश्चिमी दुर्ग; आवासीय आवासों के लिए पूर्वी निचला शहर

rows.en: Kiln-burnt bricks, stone slabs covering street drains, drop-pits and soakage jars at regular intervals
rows.hi: भट्ठी में पकी ईंटें, सड़क की नालियों को ढकने वाली पत्थर की स्लैब, नियमित अंतराल पर ड्रॉप-पिट और सोखने वाले जार

definition.en: The Harappans used kiln-burnt mud bricks predominantly adhering to a strict ratio of length:breadth:thickness (typically 4:2:1), demonstrating unified weight and measurement standards.
definition.hi: The Harappans used kiln-burnt mud bricks predominantly adhering to a strict ratio of length:breadth:thickness (typically 4:2:1), demonstrating unified weight and measurement standards.

definition.en: Every house was connected to street-level drains. Kitchen and bathroom wastewater flowed through clay pipes into covered brick-lined main drains, reflecting exceptional hygiene awareness.
definition.hi: Every house was connected to street-level drains. Kitchen and bathroom wastewater flowed through clay pipes into covered brick-lined main drains, reflecting exceptional hygiene awareness.

definition.en: Streets were wide and designed to be swept naturally by prevailing winds, cutting through the city sectors systematically to prevent stagnation.
definition.hi: Streets were wide and designed to be swept naturally by prevailing winds, cutting through the city sectors systematically to prevent stagnation.

definition.en: Buildings generally did not encroach upon public thoroughfares, indicating the existence of a municipal authority enforcing strict building codes.
definition.hi: Buildings generally did not encroach upon public thoroughfares, indicating the existence of a municipal authority enforcing strict building codes.

content.en: Unlike most Harappan cities split into a two-part layout (Citadel and Lower Town), Dholavira features a unique **three-tiered layout** comprising a citadel, a middle town, and a lower town, accompanied by massive stone walls and intricate water-harvesting reservoirs.
content.hi: Unlike most Harappan cities split into a two-part layout (Citadel and Lower Town), Dholavira features a unique **three-tiered layout** comprising a citadel, a middle town, and a lower town, accompanied by massive stone walls and intricate water-harvesting reservoirs.

content.en: Chanhudaro is a notable exception where archaeological excavations have revealed **no citadel** area, suggesting a purely industrial settlement focused on bead-making, shell-working, and seal-making.
content.hi: Chanhudaro is a notable exception where archaeological excavations have revealed **no citadel** area, suggesting a purely industrial settlement focused on bead-making, shell-working, and seal-making.

content.en: Students often assume all Harappan sites followed the identical two-part Citadel and Lower Town model. Remember that Dholavira features a tripartite division, and sites like Chanhudaro lack a citadel altogether.
